description: This file contains a Swift actor 'TestIsolationLock' for managing asynchronous locking, and an enum 'TestIsolation' providing utilities for setting temporary environment variables, user defaults, and generating temporary config file paths for isolated test environments.

classes.name: TestIsolationLock
classes.description: An actor implementing a lock mechanism to control concurrent access in asynchronous contexts.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires the lock, awaiting if it's already held.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the lock and resumes the next waiting task, if any.

methods.name: withIsolatedState
methods.description: Executes a body closure with temporarily set environment variables and user defaults, restoring previous states afterward.

methods.name: restoreEnv
methods.description: Restores environment variables to previous state.

methods.name: withEnvValues
methods.description: Runs a closure with temporary environment variables.

methods.name: withUserDefaultsValues
methods.description: Runs a closure with temporary user defaults values.

methods.name: tempConfigPath
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary file path for test configuration.
